ANTIMICROBIAL_CONTROL.definition: Resistance threats and the practices that prevent or reduce transmission and healthcare-associated infections.

BLOOD_INFECTIONS.definition: Infections transmitted by blood exposure or sexual contact (e.g., HIV, hepatitis, STIs).

CANCER_DISEASE.definition: Malignant neoplasms, including site-specific cancers and childhood cancers.

CLIMATE_HEALTH.definition: Climate hazards (heat, drought, extremes) and ecological linkages between human, animal and environmental health (One Health).

EMERGENCY_SETTINGS.definition: Acute events and humanitarian contexts, including disasters, travel health, emergency/critical care, and risk communication/infodemics.

ENTERIC_INFECTIONS.definition: Pathogens spread via contaminated water or food and fecal–oral routes, including diarrhoeal disease and many intestinal helminth infections.

ENVIRONMENTAL_HEALTH.prefLabel: Environmental, occupational & radiation health (incl. WASH & urban)
ENVIRONMENTAL_HEALTH.definition: Environmental exposures, workplace health, radiation risks, and context factors like WASH and urban living.

HEALTH_PRODUCTS.definition: Medicines, devices, diagnostics, oxygen/blood, transplantation, digital health, genomics, and R&D/clinical trials; product quality and safety.

HEALTH_SYSTEMS.prefLabel: Health systems, quality, care models & determinants
HEALTH_SYSTEMS.definition: Organization and delivery of care, quality/safety, care models, health promotion/behaviour change, and social/commercial/political determinants and population health.

IMMUNIZATION_DISEASES.definition: Vaccination programmes and diseases for which effective vaccines exist (routine and outbreak control).

INJURY_PREVENTION.definition: Unintentional injuries and toxin exposures (e.g., road traffic injuries, drowning, snakebite).

LIFECOURSE_HEALTH.prefLabel: Life-course health: maternal, newborn, child, adolescent & ageing
LIFECOURSE_HEALTH.definition: Health across life stages, including maternal, newborn, child, adolescent, and older-age health and inequities such as ageism.

MENTAL_HEALTH.definition: Mental disorders, neurological conditions, and substance use problems (including alcohol, tobacco, and drugs).

NONCOMMUNICABLE_DISEASES.definition: Chronic metabolic and cardiopulmonary conditions such as CVD, hypertension, diabetes, and chronic respiratory diseases.

NUTRITION_SECURITY.definition: Dietary status and interventions: breastfeeding/infant feeding, micronutrients, fortification, and malnutrition prevention/treatment.

REPRODUCTIVE_HEALTH.definition: SRHR across the life course, including contraception, fertility/infertility, abortion, and harmful practices (e.g., FGM).

RESPIRATORY_DISEASES.definition: Infectious diseases that primarily affect the respiratory tract (e.g., influenza viruses, coronaviruses, RSV, TB, and pneumonias).

SENSORY_HEALTH.definition: Health of the mouth/teeth, vision/eye conditions, and hearing/sensory impairments.

TROPICAL_DISEASES.prefLabel: Neglected tropical, parasitic & fungal skin diseases
TROPICAL_DISEASES.definition: NTDs and other parasitic/fungal diseases with major burden in tropical settings; many affect skin and soft tissues.

VECTOR_DISEASES.definition: Infections transmitted by vectors (e.g., mosquitoes, ticks) or originating in animals with spillover to humans (arboviruses, viral haemorrhagic fevers, rabies/plague).
